paper_title: Robust cosmological constraints on axion-like particles
notes: Paper presents cosmological constraints on axion-like particles (ALPs) coupling to photons via the Lagrangian term g_φγ/4 φ F_μν F̃^μν. Main results are shown in Figures 4, 5, and 6 as exclusion regions in the m_φ–τ_φ plane and m_φ–g_φγ plane. The coupling type is AxionPhoton (g_φγ). Data points extracted represent approximate bounds from Figure 6 (right panel) showing the combined BBN and Planck N_eff constraints at 95% C.L. in the standard scenario (blue dashed line). The paper derives robust constraints from Big Bang Nucleosynthesis (BBN) using primordial abundances of Yp, D/1H, and 3He/D, combined with Planck CMB measurements. The bounds are mass-dependent and span from ~0.01 MeV to ~1000 MeV. Extraction confidence is moderate (0.65) because: (1) the coupling type is unambiguous from the paper's focus on g_φγ coupling, (2) numerical values are not explicitly tabulated but must be read from exclusion plots, (3) the paper discusses multiple scenarios (standard, low reheating, extra N_eff, neutrino chemical potential) which weakens the single 'new limit' claim. The data points provided are approximate representative bounds spanning the parameter space; precise numerical extraction from the figures is limited by resolution. | selector: text (sole candidate)
